description: This is a React component implementing a front-end notes application UI, including state management, note creation, editing, deletion, and search functionality.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Generates a simple unique identifier string for notes.

methods.name: handleSelectNote
methods.description: Sets the selected note by its ID and exits editing mode.

methods.name: handleCreateNote
methods.description: Creates a new untitled note, adds it to the state, and enters editing mode.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation and updates the selected note accordingly.

methods.name: handleEditStart
methods.description: Enters editing mode for the current note.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Saves the edited note content and updates the notes state.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Updates the search term state based on user input.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Exits editing mode without saving changes.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string.
